question: Do I need to know how to code before joining this bootcamp?
answer: Not at all! Even if you've never coded before, you can still join. We'll start from the basics, so you'll be fine.

question: If I'm not an IT major, will I find it difficult?
answer: Don't worry! Our materials are designed to be easy to follow, even for those who are new to the world of data.

question: What is the quota for DSMBC?
answer: The quota is still confidential, please wait for the official announcement!

question: Are all DSMBC sessions held online?
answer: Not all. Day 0 will be online via Zoom, while Day 1 & 2 will be offline.

question: Where does DSMBC take place?
answer:
● Day 0: Online (Zoom)
● Day 1 & 2: Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Brawijaya

question: Will I get a certificate at the end of the session?
answer: Yes! All participants who attend the entire series of events will receive a certificate, and winners of the Kaggle Competition will receive a special certificate!

question: If I don't attend all the activities, can I still get a participant certificate?
answer: Nope. Participant certificates are only given if you attend all events. If there’s an unavoidable issue, please contact the CP listed below.
